title: Spinal Cord Stimulation: Trial and Permanent Implantation (Synthetic Health Plan — fictional policy)

children.text: Chronic neuropathic trunk/limb pain present at least 6 months

sourceSpan.quote: Chronic neuropathic pain of the trunk or limbs (for example, persistent pain after spinal surgery or complex regional pain syndrome) has been present for at least 6 months.

present: {date}: Persistent neuropathic left leg pain for 18 months following L4-5 laminectomy.

children.text: Failed at least 6 months of multidisciplinary conservative treatment

sourceSpan.quote: The member has failed at least 6 months of multidisciplinary conservative treatment, including physical therapy, medication management, and when appropriate interventional procedures.

present: {date}: Over 9 months of PT, gabapentin and duloxetine trials, and two epidural injections without durable relief.

children.text: Psychological evaluation within 12 months found no untreated psychiatric condition, active substance use disorder or unrealistic expectations

sourceSpan.quote: A psychological evaluation by a licensed mental health professional within the past 12 months has found no untreated psychiatric condition, active substance use disorder, or unrealistic expectations that would preclude a successful outcome.

children.suggestedFix: Attach the psychological evaluation (within 12 months) clearing the patient for neuromodulation.

present: {date}: Psychological evaluation by licensed psychologist: no untreated psychiatric condition or substance use disorder; realistic expectations. Cleared for SCS trial.
negated: {date}: Psychology referral placed; evaluation not yet completed.
contradicted: {date}: Psychological evaluation: active untreated major depression; not cleared.

children.text: Further surgery is not indicated or the member is not a surgical candidate

sourceSpan.quote: Further surgical intervention is not indicated or the member is not a surgical candidate.

present: {date}: Spine surgery consult: no further surgical options indicated.

children.text: No contraindication to implantation (e.g., active infection, uncorrected coagulopathy)

sourceSpan.quote: The member has no contraindication to implantation, such as active infection or uncorrected coagulopathy.

present: {date}: No active infection; INR 1.0, platelets normal; no anticoagulants.
contradicted: {date}: Active cellulitis at the planned implant site.
